scenario: A K-12 district uses an agent pipeline to pre-screen students for gifted-and-talented program placement. The pipeline ingests a student academic record CSV containing GPA, standardized assessment scores, teacher nominations, and school of origin, normalizes the data, analyzes the student's assessment writing sample for language sophistication, computes a gifted-eligibility composite score, and produces a placement recommendation memo (Recommend / Not Recommend / Waitlist).
info_flow: ub2-csv-data-analyzer loads the student record CSV and produces a normalized data summary with computed fields -> nlp-toolkit analyzes the writing sample and produces language metrics -> reporting combines both outputs into a gifted-eligibility composite score and placement recommendation memo.
